surat_perjanjian_pasal_count._verification: Confirmed by manual read: the real Surat Perjanjian (p.1-4) has Pasal 1-5, and the blank KSO specimen form (p.5-8) repeats the SAME Pasal 1-5 titles verbatim as its own copy. surat_perjanjian_pasal_count._known_bug_false_positive_article: The phrase 'dengan mengesampingkan Pasal 1266 dan 1267 Kitab Undang-Undang Hukum Perdata' (a legal citation inside SSUK clause 44, p.24) wraps onto its own line exactly at 'Pasal 1266 dan 1267 Kitab Undang-...', and tree.py's article_word regex (`^\s*(PASAL|Pasal)\s+(\d+)\b`) has no scoping guard (unlike decimal_plain's clause-scope check) — it fires unconditionally anywhere in the document. This produces a spurious 11th 'article' node labelled 'PASAL 1266'. Confirmed this citation exists verbatim in the ORIGINAL sample PDF too (clause 44's body) but does NOT produce a false article there — apparently the line-wrap coincidence needed to trigger it is specific to this document's page width/column layout. expected=10 excludes this false positive; current pipeline output is 11.
